headline: PENTAGON WEIGHS LOAN
dek: ProPublica reports a loan of up to $15 billion is under discussion for Hadrian Automation. The Pentagon disputes the figure.

nodes.text: Donald Trump Jr. joins venture firm 1789 Capital as a partner after his father's election.
1789 Capital invests in Hadrian, an AI-and-robotics defense manufacturer.
Hadrian raises $1.37 billion with “major participation by 1789 Capital.”
ProPublica: Pentagon weighs a loan to build a dozen automated factories, almost twice the company's value.

means.label: The Pentagon:
means.text: Talks are in “early stages.” “Outside affiliations, investors, or political connections play absolutely no role.”

means.label: 1789 Capital:
means.text: Holds a “minority stake” and does not get involved in government contracts its companies seek.

means.label: The concerns:
means.text: Former defense officials told ProPublica the deal could strain rules meant to protect taxpayer money.

sources: Sources: ProPublica, Nov. 24; Hadrian Series D announcement (PR Newswire); Pentagon and 1789 Capital statements via ProPublica.
